human_actions_pending.action: Decide whether to resume plan 04-12 from the pushed worktree branch or restart it clean
human_actions_pending.context: Two of four tasks are already built and committed on worktree-agent-a89cf10a707dfba36. Restarting clean discards roughly 30 minutes of verified work; resuming from the branch requires dispatching into a worktree forked from that branch rather than from the phase branch.

decisions.decision: Merged plan 04-10's worktree by hand with --ff-only instead of through worktree.cleanup-wave
decisions.rationale: The cleanup helper blocks unconditionally on any branch containing a file deletion and exposes no approval flag; its own source records the opt-in as deferred upstream. Plan 04-10's stated purpose was deleting four files, every deleted path was inside the plan's declared files_modified, the base matched exactly and a fast-forward was available. User confirmed this handling should continue for the remaining deletion plans, with a note in each wave summary.

decisions.decision: Resolved plan 04-11's human-verify checkpoint in-session rather than handing it to the user
decisions.rationale: CLAUDE.md requires driving any checkpoint through the running app before presenting it. The executor had no browser MCP tool available; the orchestrator did. Six Storybook stories spanning all three server-action cutover groups were checked headless: zero errors, zero warnings, only React's standard DevTools info notice.

decisions.decision: Push every executor worktree branch that holds task commits before ending a session
decisions.rationale: GSD executor branches are local-only and self-delete with their worktree, so unmerged task commits are otherwise lost at the pause boundary.
